runs.content: Rockwell Automation (ROK) picked up at the previous close ($462.16) after raising FY26 EPS guidance on a Q2 beat — up 32.7% over three months with Zacks Rank #1 momentum, chosen over chip-sector momentum to stay clear of Burry's semiconductor short thesis. No exits today: all 27 legacy positions repriced with no new stop-loss, T1, or T2 triggers; Burry's short list (re-read today) added MU and CAT as direct shorts, newly flagging open position MU (+2.80%, WATCH — above water).

Investar Holding (ISTR) picked up at the previous close ($29.32) — a Louisiana community bank trading at ~13x trailing / ~9.3x forward P/E and ~1.2x book value despite double-digit revenue and earnings growth. Exits today: LHA (Lufthansa) hit the 60-day max-hold limit and closed for a blended +18.2% (+$182), the portfolio's largest closed win; CMCSA dropped to −9.50% on a high-volume selloff and is now within $1.33 of its stop.
